usedFor: Raisely holds donations, and “Donation Succeeded” can write into Google Docs via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Online Donation” in Raisely, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Card or PayPal donations to your campaign can be listed in the doc as online gifts.

watchOut: “New Campaign” in Raisely is polling, so its doc update arrives after a short delay.
